You are a code worker. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. Edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit, push, or touch .git. You own exactly these files and nothing else: frontend/e2e/affordances.js, frontend/e2e/affordances.test.js, frontend/e2e/affordances.spec.js, frontend/e2e/scene-walk.js, frontend/e2e/scene-walk.test.js. Do NOT edit any existing file (not helpers.js, canon-journey.js, scene-runtime.spec.js, package.json, playwright.config.js, or anything under bench/ or storygame/ or data/): import from them, copy logic from them, never change them. The tests you write must NEVER call the live game, a live model or the network: they are hermetic node:test tests with injected fakes. Only the .spec.js file touches the hosted game, and you must NOT run it (no E2E_API_BASE_URL is available to you; running it would spend a billed budget).

GOAL: "L1 @affordances" from .plans/scene-affordance-e2e.md (read sections 4-L1, 5, 8 and 10 first). The hosted-game test proves the PLAYER IS SHOWN what each scene needs: for scene S it reads exactly what the player reads (the opening plus the narration of a short fixed exploration) and checks that every first-step affordance from the L0 map is named in it. Motivating case: in scene 1A the narrator's prompt carries the KMS-initials drawer, but the hosted opening never names the drawer or the workstation, so the player cannot know what to do. The test must be derived from the story package (via the L0 map) for ANY scene and ANY story: no scene ids, entity ids, or story words hard-coded in affordances.js or the spec (the scene list comes from an env var and the map).

READ FIRST (read-only): AGENTS.md section "Writing Player Input" (the exploration input must follow it: imperative, verb plus object, never first person, no non-events); frontend/e2e/helpers.js (startSceneSession, submitTurn, installPackageClock, resolveWarningIfPresent, writeCategoryReport); frontend/e2e/canon-journey.js (scenePrompts, promptFor, used only to travel to later scenes); frontend/e2e/scene-runtime.spec.js tests "@llm-canon" and "@smoke" (the pattern for scenes, the package clock, milestones, segments, grounding_ids; copy the walking logic, do not import it); frontend/e2e/package-clock.js; frontend/e2e/roleplay-judge.test.js (hermetic test style); bench/affordance_map.py and its CLI (`uv run python -m bench.affordance_map --package <dir>` prints the map JSON on stdout) and sample output at /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/affordance-l0b/continuity-initiative.json if it exists (else build one with the CLI). Map shape: {story_id, protagonist_id, scenes:[{scene_id, location:{id,name,aliases}, entry_material, gates:[{transition_id, fact_id, sources:[{id,kind,player_earned,reveals:[...]}], affordances:[{entity_id,name,aliases,kind,source,visible_at_entry,revealed_by}]}]}], findings}.

BUILD frontend/e2e/affordances.js (pure ESM, no top-level side effects), exporting:
- loadAffordanceMap(packageDir, {exec = execFileSync, cwd = repo root} = {}): runs `uv run python -m bench.affordance_map --package <packageDir>` with env TMPDIR=/tmp from the repo root, parses stdout JSON, throws a clear error on failure.
- normalizeText(text): lowercases, converts curly quotes/dashes to ASCII, collapses whitespace.
- mentions(text, terms): true when any term (name or alias, normalised, regex-escaped) occurs as a whole word or phrase in the text. Possessive and plural tolerant: "Michelle's workstation" matches "workstation", "drawers" matches "drawer" is NOT required, keep it strict whole-word.
- firstStepAffordances(map, sceneId): the gate affordances for the scene with visible_at_entry true, de-duplicated by entity_id, each with {entity_id, name, aliases, kind, gates:[gate ids], terms:[name,...aliases]}.
- laterAffordances(map, sceneId): the rest (revealed_by set), de-duplicated the same way.
- exploreInput(sceneEntry): `Search the ${location.name}.` after stripping a leading "the " from the name; throws if the scene has no location.
- measureScene({sceneEntry, shownLog}): shownLog is [{turn: 0 for the opening, 1.. for each turn, text}]; returns {scene_id, input, first_step: [{entity_id, name, first_shown_turn (number or null), snippet (about 80 chars around the first match or null), deadline_met (shown at turn 0 or 1)}], later: [{entity_id, name, first_shown_turn, snippet}], summary:{first_step_total, shown_by_deadline, never_shown}}.
- formatMarkdown(report): a compact per-scene table (affordance, first shown turn or NEVER, snippet).
Deadline (decision D1): a first-step affordance should be named in the opening or by the end of the first exploring turn. Decision D3: the spec REPORTS rates and never fails on a missing affordance; it fails only if the harness itself broke (no opening text, no narration on the explore turn, map has no such scene).

BUILD frontend/e2e/scene-walk.js: a small reusable walker so L1 (and later L2) can travel to a scene. Export async walkScenes({page, pacing, controller, sceneIds, onOpening, onTurn, maxTurns = 45, exploreFor}) that mirrors the @llm-canon loop (canon-journey prompts per scene via promptFor, the milestone/controller.arm logic, resolveWarningIfPresent, the one-scene-at-a-time guard) but: stops after the LAST requested scene has had its explore turn; in every requested scene, the first turn is exploreFor(sceneId) instead of the canon prompt (so the exploring turn counts toward that scene's pacing); calls onOpening({scene_id, text, via}) once per scene reached (for 1A the first .entry-output text from the DOM, for later scenes the final narration segment of the entering turn) and onTurn({scene_id, turn, input, text, payload}) per turn, where text is the joined narration/action/dialogue/speech segment text of that turn exactly as the player reads it. The segments of an entering turn other than the final one belong to the scene being left. Keep it dependency-injectable (page, submitTurn and the clock are passed in or imported lazily) so scene-walk.test.js can drive it with fakes and cover: walking 1A only, walking 1A then 1B, the explore turn replacing the first canon prompt, the departure-segments split, and a stall guard error.

BUILD frontend/e2e/affordances.spec.js with one Playwright test titled "shows the player what each scene needs @affordances": skipped unless E2E_API_BASE_URL is set; refuses (test fails with a clear message) unless GET <E2E_API_BASE_URL>/api/v1/version reports channel "staging" (never run against production); reads E2E_AFFORDANCE_SCENES (comma list, default "1A") and E2E_AFFORDANCE_REPLICATES (default 1); loads the map with loadAffordanceMap("data/stories/<story folder>") where the story folder is found by scanning data/stories for the package whose story_id is "continuity_initiative" (the same id canon-journey uses); for each replicate starts a fresh session with the package clock when any scene after 1A is requested (E2E_PACKAGE_CLOCK semantics: reuse installPackageClock exactly as @llm-canon does, and set test.setTimeout(20 * 60_000)); walks to each requested scene with scene-walk.js; builds each scene's shownLog from onOpening and onTurn; runs measureScene; writes writeCategoryReport("affordances", {scenes:[...per replicate...]}) which creates artifacts/e2e-affordances.{json,md} and put the markdown table into the md. Hard cap: the spec must refuse to run more than 20 turns per replicate-scene and more than 3 replicates (billed-endpoint guard), and must say so.

BUILD frontend/e2e/affordances.test.js and scene-walk.test.js (node:test, hermetic): cover mentions (name, alias, case, curly apostrophe, whole-word negative such as "bench" vs "benched", multiword alias), firstStepAffordances de-duplication, measureScene (shown in opening, shown on turn 1, shown only on turn 3 -> deadline_met false, never shown -> null), exploreInput (strips "the", rejects missing location, follows the player-input rules: no "I", ends with a period, starts with a verb), formatMarkdown, and loadAffordanceMap with an injected exec returning a fixture and one that throws.

HOW TO RUN (from the worktree root): cd frontend && node --test e2e/affordances.test.js e2e/scene-walk.test.js ; and a free live read of the real map: cd .. && node --input-type=module -e 'import {loadAffordanceMap, firstStepAffordances} from "./frontend/e2e/affordances.js"; const m=loadAffordanceMap("data/stories/continuity-initiative"); console.log(firstStepAffordances(m,"1A").map(x=>x.entity_id))'. If frontend/node_modules is missing run `ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/frontend/node_modules frontend/node_modules` (never npm install). The check also requires that `playwright test --list --grep @affordances` lists your test and that 1A first-step affordances include michelle_drawer and michelle_workstation.

OUTPUT: also write ./notes.md at the worktree root (not git-added) with: files read, any judgment you made, and the exact wording of every player input the spec can send.
